title: HabitTracker – Build habits that stick
description: HabitTracker is a simple, private habit tracker for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Check in each day, get reminders, run timers and follow your streaks.
og_description: A simple, private habit tracker for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
hero_lead: Check in each day, get a gentle reminder when you need one, and watch your streaks grow. A simple, private habit tracker for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch.
hero_status: Coming soon to the App Store.
hero_phone_alt: The Habits list, grouped into Morning, Evening and Any Time, with a check-in button on each habit
hero_watch_alt: The Apple Watch app's Today screen
features_title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.
features_lead: Track the habits you want to build and the ones you want to leave behind, your way.
feature_habits_text: Pick an icon, a color and an animation. Repeat on chosen weekdays or any 3 times a week, once a day or several times, like 8 glasses of water.
feature_routines_text: Group your day into Morning, Afternoon and Evening, and drag your habits into the order you like.
feature_timers_text: For habits measured in minutes, like reading 30 minutes a day. Start and pause from the list or your wrist, and get notified when you're done.
feature_quit_text: Smoking, sugar, late-night scrolling: count the days clean since your last slip.
feature_reminders_text: One a day, or spread through the day (“3 of 8”), with Done and Check In buttons right in the notification.
feature_days_off_text: Skip a sick day, pause a habit, or pause them all for a vacation, without breaking your streaks.
feature_statistics_text: Completion rate, streaks, a consistency heatmap, your best weekdays, and a year calendar for every habit.
feature_milestones_text: Celebrate 7, 30 and 100-day streaks, and share a streak as an image card.
feature_siri_text: “Check in Morning Run in HabitTracker”, or ask “What's left today in HabitTracker”. Works in Spotlight and with the Action button too.
feature_ipad_mac_text: Your habits in a sidebar, with each habit's statistics beside them, and keyboard shortcuts on the Mac.
feature_data_text: Export everything to CSV for a spreadsheet, and back up and restore through the Files app.
feature_yours_text: Six app icons, and the app in English, Italiano, Français or Español, whatever your device's language.
screenshots_lead: Designed for iOS 26, with Liquid Glass, haptics and VoiceOver throughout.
shot_statistics_alt: The Statistics tab with completion rate, check-ins, perfect days and current streak
shot_charts_alt: A 16-week consistency heatmap and completion by weekday
shot_year_alt: A habit's page with its streak, completion, milestones and year calendar
shot_timer_alt: A timer counting down to a 15-minute goal
shot_editor_alt: Editing a habit: its icon, color, style and animation
watch_lead: The Apple Watch app shows today's habits and syncs with your iPhone, so you can check in without reaching for your phone.
watch_item_check_in: Check in with a tap, or set the count with the Digital Crown
watch_item_skip: Skip a day or log a slip
watch_item_statistics: Weekly and monthly statistics, and your longest streaks
watch_item_milestones: Milestone celebrations, right on your wrist
watch_habit_alt: A habit's progress ring on Apple Watch
privacy_lead: HabitTracker doesn't collect any data. What you track is between you and your devices.
privacy_account_text: Open the app and start. There's nothing to sign up for.
privacy_tracking_text: No ads, no analytics and no third-party code.
privacy_device_text: Your habits are stored on your device, and the Apple Watch syncs directly with your iPhone.
contact_title: We'd love to hear from you.
contact_lead: Questions, ideas, or something that doesn't work as it should? Send an email and we'll get back to you.
faq_download_answer: It's almost ready: a beta on TestFlight comes first, then the App Store. This page will link to it as soon as it's out.
faq_devices_question: Which devices does it run on?
faq_devices_answer: iPhone and iPad with iOS 26 or later, Mac with macOS 26 or later, and Apple Watch with watchOS 26 or later, paired with an iPhone.
faq_support_question: Can I contact support from the app?
faq_support_answer: Yes: Settings › Support › Contact Support writes an email with details that help us find a problem, like the app version, your device and iOS version. It never includes your habits' names, notes or places, and you see everything before you send it.
faq_new_iphone_question: How do I move my habits to a new iPhone?
faq_new_iphone_answer: In Settings › Backup, choose Back Up to Files and save the file somewhere you can reach from the new iPhone, like iCloud Drive. Then, on the new iPhone, choose Restore from Backup.
faq_skip_question: Can I skip a day without losing my streak?
faq_skip_answer: Yes. Swipe a habit and choose Skip Today, turn on Paused when editing a habit, or use Settings › Vacation to pause all of them. Paused days never count as missed.
